from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
import json

class Hou_Mcp_Runtime_Capabilities(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_runtime_capabilities"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("capability_type",  "string", widget_type="text",     default="")
        self.add_input("include_metadata", "bool",   widget_type="checkbox", default=True)
        self.add_output("capabilities", "list")
        self.add_output("count",        "int")
        self.add_output("types",        "list")
        self.add_output("report_json",  "string")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        from src.runtime.capability_registry import get_capability_registry
        cap_type = str(inputs.get("capability_type") or "").strip() or None
        include_meta = bool(inputs.get("include_metadata", True))

        registry = get_capability_registry()
        raw = registry.query_capabilities(cap_type=cap_type)

        if not include_meta:
            capabilities = [{"type": c["type"], "id": c["id"]} for c in raw]
        else:
            capabilities = raw

        types = sorted(set(c["type"] for c in raw))
        report = {"capabilities": capabilities, "count": len(capabilities), "types": types}

        return {
            "exec_out":     True,
            "capabilities": capabilities,
            "count":        len(capabilities),
            "types":        types,
            "report_json":  json.dumps(report),
        }

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Runtime_Capabilities
